# posthog-mcp

> MCP server: PostHog events, persons, flags, experiments, insights, cohorts, groups, and project tools for AI agents. Mock by default. Gemini/Groq agent evals optional.

## Summary

posthog-mcp exposes ~25 Model Context Protocol tools so agents can read and write a useful PostHog surface without a browser. Default transport is stdio. Default backend is an in-memory mock; optional live PostHog via env. Evaluation suite compares Gemini or Groq agents with and without tools on ~80 tasks.

## Tool groups

- Events/users: capture_event, identify_user, get_person, list_persons, get_person_events
- Flags/experiments: get_feature_flag, list_feature_flags, get_feature_flag_definition, create_feature_flag, update_feature_flag, list_experiments, get_experiment
- Insights: query_trends, query_funnel, query_retention, list_insights, get_insight
- Cohorts/groups: list_cohorts, get_cohort, get_cohort_persons, list_group_types, list_groups, find_group
- Project: get_project, list_dashboards

## Modes

- mock (default): no credentials; seeded persons, events, flags, experiments, cohorts, groups, insights, dashboards
- live: POSTHOG_MODE=live + POSTHOG_API_KEY (+ POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY, POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID, POSTHOG_HOST)

## Run

```
npm install
npm test
npm run eval:agent
npm run eval:compare
npm run dev
```

## Docs

- AGENT.md — agent operating manual
- README.md — human setup and MCP host config
- docs/evaluation.md — dataset, scoring, provider reports

## Constraints

- No auth server, no database, no HTTP MCP endpoint in this slice
- stdout is JSON-RPC only; use stderr for logs
- Flag writes require confirm=true; no delete tools
- Agent evals use Gemini (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) or Groq (openai/gpt-oss-120b); CI does not call LLMs
